_about: Tissue values for the body's walking simulations (tools/body_walk.py). Muscle, fat and skin are Rafael's rafa8 values from the thigh; the cavity (organs) is declared by eye. Edit to change; a run can override one as NAME=value. Units: Pa, kg/m3, 1/s, steps per frame. REGIONS overrides by tissue and zone, {tissue: {zone: {young, density, poisson, damping}}}; empty means the defaults everywhere.
_source: rafa8 (2026-11-07) for SUBSTEPS to POISSON; CAVITY_* declared 2026-11-07
